title: The Ark Brought from Kiriath-jearim

questions.question: Who did David consult with before bringing the ark?
options: The commanders of thousands and of hundreds
questions.correctAnswer: The commanders of thousands and of hundreds
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:1 (ESV): "David consulted with the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader."

questions.question: From where did they bring the ark of God?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:5-6 (ESV): "...to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim."

questions.question: How did they transport the ark?
options: On the shoulders of the Levites
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:7 (ESV): "And they carried the ark of God on a new cart..."

questions.question: Who drove the cart?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:7 (ESV): "...Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart."

questions.question: What happened to Uzza?
options: The LORD struck him down because he put out his hand to the ark
He was bitten by a snake
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD struck him down because he put out his hand to the ark
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:10 (ESV): "...struck him down because he put out his hand to the ark, and he died there before God."

questions.question: Why did Uzza put out his hand to the ark?
What was the place called where Uzza died?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:11 (ESV): "...and that place is called Perez-uzza to this day."

questions.question: Where did David take the ark after he was afraid?
options: To the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
questions.correctAnswer: To the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:13 (ESV): "...but took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite."

questions.question: How long did the ark remain with the household of Obed-edom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:14 (ESV): "And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in his house three months."

questions.question: What happened to Obed-edom's household?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:14 (ESV): "...And the LORD blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that he had."

questions.question: What is another name given for Kiriath-jearim in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:6 (ESV): "...to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim..."

questions.question: From where did David say they should bring back the ark (location/people)?
options: All Israel, from the Shihor of Egypt to Lebo-hamath
questions.correctAnswer: All Israel, from the Shihor of Egypt to Lebo-hamath
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:5 (ESV): "So David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt to Lebo-hamath..."

questions.question: Whouse house was the ark at in Kiriath-jearim?
How did David and all Israel celebrate before God?
options: With all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets
questions.correctAnswer: With all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:8 (ESV): "And David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might..."

questions.question: Why did David want to bring back the ark?
options: Because they did not seek it in the days of Saul
questions.correctAnswer: Because they did not seek it in the days of Saul
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 13:3 (ESV): "Then let us bring again the ark of our God to us, for we did not seek it in the days of Saul."

key_verse_text: And David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.
